hooks.cost: 0 tokens; about 50 ms per Bash call (measured on one Linux box); prints ~60 tokens only when it blocks.
hooks.description: Blocks git --no-verify (and commit -n), hook-disabling config, and force-push. Blocks while it runs; if the launcher file is missing the command exits 127, which Claude Code does not treat as blocking.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens; about 60 ms per Bash call (measured on one Linux box), more only for a git commit or git add that scans a diff; prints a short file:line list only when it blocks.
hooks.description: Blocks git commit when an added line looks like a secret, and git add of key and .env files. Blocks while it runs; if the launcher file is missing the command exits 127, which Claude Code does not treat as blocking.

hooks.cost: One Sonnet run per session with 5+ human turns and no manual handoff; capped by --max-budget-usd 1.00, --max-turns 25 and a 900 s wall clock.
hooks.description: Writes a handoff via the real /handoff skill when the session did not run one.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens; about 70 ms per tool call; appends one scrubbed line to a local file under ~/.grid/instincts/, prints nothing.
hooks.description: Records which tool ran and a scrubbed, truncated summary of its input, only in a project with learning: on.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens; about 70 ms per failed tool call; appends one scrubbed line to a local file, prints nothing.
hooks.description: Records a failed tool call with an error flag, only in a project with learning: on.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens; about 70 ms per prompt; appends one scrubbed, truncated line to a local file, prints nothing.
hooks.description: Records a scrubbed, truncated copy of each prompt, only in a project with learning: on.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens to run; prints a few short habit hints (about 100 to 300 tokens) into the session when any instincts exist, nothing otherwise.
hooks.description: Prints the project's learned habit hints at session start, only in a project with learning: on.

hooks.cost: 0 tokens to run; about 60 ms per stop; a block adds one model turn, once per turn
hooks.description: Asks once per turn for RAN, READ or UNTESTED when the last message claims completion without one; advisory only.
